canonical_title: Fire protection system displays and controls

versions.title_at_revision: Fire protection system displays and controls
versions.text:
Standard: Flight crew station information, including any WCAs and controls, are available to notify the flight crew of the system operating conditions, and allow operation of the FPS. Flight crew are able to check the functioning of each fire detector circuit during all flight and ground conditions. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Conduct inspection of design documents to show interface requirements for the FPS displays, controls, and information (including any WCAs) needed to monitor and operate the system to prevent, suppress, extinguish, or mitigate the effects of a fire are defined.
(2) Conduct inspection of design documents to show the controls, displays, and information (including any WCAs) provided to the flight crew allows for the operation of the FPS to prevent, suppress, extinguish, or mitigate the effects of a fire.
(3) Conduct inspection of design documents to show there are means to allow the flight crew to check the functioning of each fire detector circuit during all flight and ground conditions. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct analysis to show the controls, displays, and information (including any WCAs) provided to the flight crew allows for the operation of the FPS under all operational conditions to prevent, suppress, extinguish, or mitigate the effects of a fire. Test.
    (1) Ground test: Conduct ground test to show the controls, displays, and information (including any WCAs) provided to the flight crew allows for the operation of the FPS to prevent, suppress, extinguish, or mitigate the effects of a fire.
    (2) Ground test: Conduct ground test to show there are means to allow the flight crew to check the functioning of each fire detector circuit during all flight and ground conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (3) Flight test: Conduct flight test to show the controls, displays, and information (including any WCAs) provided to the flight crew allows for the operation of the FPS to prevent, suppress, extinguish, or mitigate the effects of a fire.
